finding: After installing 1.3.0 (9) the stop fired on the live store, but the app still averaged 11.4% of one core over 15 minutes (103 CPU-s / 900 s) and 13.8% over a quiet 3-minute window with no activity from the operator; GATE-649 requires below 2%.
cause: Every file change in a busy watched folder scheduled a sample 0.5 s later. In the stopped state each sample still recomputed the full lifecycle status (storage accounting, full-table counts) and enumerated mounted volumes. A 60 s profile of the installed app attributes ~9.4 of 60 s to sampling: lifecycleStatus 7.1 s (storageAccounting 6.0 s), VolumeSnapshotService.capture 2.3 s.
fix: Stopped samples reuse the lifecycle status for up to 30 minutes; the controller schedules no event-triggered sample while detail is stopped or unavailable (checked when scheduling and when the debounced sample fires); capacity stays on the regular interval.
